svg.text: packages/domain/src/ride/ride.definition.ts — what the framework fixes, and what the ride domain names
Fixed by the DSL. Identical in every flow you write.
Names you choose. Resolved from your own registries.
Trimmed for the diagram; the real file has 20 stages.

svg.text: The whole flow is one typed, Zod-validated data
structure — data, not control flow. Compiled
TypeScript today; the same shape is what Phase 3

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: An index for finding a definition. NOT what makes
replay safe — each run pins a frozen definition
snapshot and content hash at start time.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: State that runs parallel to the stage. Both the track
name and its values are yours; an undeclared value

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: A stage is a resting point. pendingRole is who the
flow is waiting on — it is what the task-queue
projection reads to build someone's inbox.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: A named edge out of a stage. Action names must be
unique flow-wide; reusing one trips the

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: Arrives as a command from outside. Every human
action must declare an authorization policy or

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: Work that runs on arrival, before anyone is waiting.
It re-runs on re-entry, so every activity behind it

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: The escape hatch. A name resolved from your registry
at runtime — that is how the definition stays
serializable while the logic stays in code.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: A pure function returning a system action name or
undefined. It may only target system actions

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: Cannot be commanded from outside. Only a rule or an
SLA escalation is allowed to fire one.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: Template and channel names, resolved from your

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: A durable timer that fires an action when nobody acts.
Format is 15s / 2m / 24h — ISO-8601 fails to parse.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: Is this transition legal right now, given facts an
activity fetched? Deliberately separate from policy,
which asks whether this actor may attempt it.
